messages.content: Vaccines train your immune system to recognize and fight specific diseases without you having to get sick first. They contain weakened, dead, or partial versions of a pathogen (or instructions for your cells to make a harmless piece of it), which triggers your immune system to produce antibodies and memory cells. Then if you encounter the real disease later, your immune system already knows how to respond quickly and effectively.
